title: HDT run state document (state.json)
description: DESIGN 4.3's state document: the resolved variables, the step index, the per-step results and the autologon lifecycle of one deployment run. Written to X:\HDT\state.json in WinPE, mirrored to the target volume as soon as one is formatted, and read back on every resume. Assert-HDTRunStateDocument is the engine's own validator and must agree with this schema on every document.

schemaVersion.description: Exactly 1. A newer version means the workspace was written by a newer engine, and the engine is upgraded rather than the document downgraded.

status.description: Running until the sequence ends. Succeeded or Failed is what makes the run abandoned to the boot reconcile.

seq.description: The last JSONL seq number written. This is how DESIGN 4.4.2's monotonic seq survives a reboot.

startedUtc.description: ISO 8601 round-trip format, as a STRING. A raw datetime serialises as \/Date(...)\/ under Windows PowerShell 5.1, which is the engine that writes this file in WinPE.

updatedUtc.description: Stamped on every save. A Running document whose updatedUtc is older than the age limit is an abandoned deployment.

stepIndex.description: The 1-based index of the NEXT step to run. It advances past a Completed or Skipped step and stays put for a Failed one, so a failed run resumes at the failure rather than after it.

pauseOnError.description: DESIGN 4.3's LTISuspend equivalent: drop to a prompt with the state loaded rather than ending the sequence.

variable.description: The resolved variables, name to value. Values may be scalars or lists.

step.description: One record per flattened step, in index order.

deploymentPassword.description: The per-deployment random Administrator secret (DESIGN 4.5.2), or null once teardown has cleared it.

group.description: The group path this step sits under, outermost first.

attempt.description: How many times this step has been started. 0 until it first runs.

leg.description: Which leg last touched this step, so a resume can say 'completed on leg 1' rather than 'on some earlier leg'. Null until it runs.

resumable.description: DESIGN 4.3: on resume the engine re-runs an interrupted step only if it declares resumable.

autoLogon.description: DESIGN 4.5's autologon lifecycle, so the boot reconcile can tear down exactly what was armed.

countSet.description: The AutoLogonCount the engine wrote: the number of legs remaining.
